messages:
maria.support: Hey team — escalation from a customer (Acme Corp). They're calling our rerank endpoint and getting a 413 / ambiguous error. Customer payload attached below. They say the error message doesn't say whether the query, a doc, or the total number of docs triggered the limit. Can someone triage?

Customer repro (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \ \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \ \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ \ 
  -d '{"query":"How to configure SSO for our app?","documents":["<doc1...very long...>","<doc2...>","<doc3...>", /* ~220 docs total */ ] }'
```

Response they get: HTTP 413
{ "error": "Payload Too Large" }

Support notes: customer insists they were never told a per-request doc count limit, just token limits in docs. They tried reducing docs to 100 and got a different error message (same generic 413). Ticket: #INC-5142.

josh.support: Thanks @maria.support. I tried repro locally with a synthetic set (~230 small docs) and a long query; I see a 413 too. On our edge logs for request_id=abcd-ef12 I see: `RERANK_INPUT_TOO_LARGE` and metric payload_bytes=1.8MB, token_estimate=12500. Our public docs say 8k token limit but not how we surface which field hit it. Customer confusion is valid.

kevin.eng: Pinging in. Quick notes from runtime traces: we compute a combined token count = tokens(query) + sum(tokens(each doc)). If combined > model_max_tokens we short-circuit with 413 and an internal code `RERANK_INPUT_TOO_LARGE`. No further breakdown is returned to avoid leaking lengths? That was the original rationale but clearly not helpful.

kevin.eng: Repro steps I used:
```
- POST /v1/rerank
- model: rwd-relevance-1
- query: ~350 tokens
- 230 docs @ ~50 tokens each -> combined ~12550
```
Edge log snippet: `2026-03-12T14:12:02Z RERANK_INPUT_TOO_LARGE req=abcd-ef12 model=rwd-relevance-1 combined_tokens=12550 limit=8192`

olga.product: This is a UX problem. Customers need actionable guidance: which part to shorten and how to batch. Product request: change the error body to include structured fields: `code`, `message`, `limit`, `provided`, `offender` (one of `query|docs|combined|num_docs`). Also a short `how_to_fix` string and a link to a KB. Can we do a small change without breaking clients?

kevin.eng: Short-term options:
- 1) Return a richer JSON with the same HTTP status (413) but add `code` and `details` (non-breaking for typical clients that only check status).
- 2) Add a `X-RW-Error-Code` response header with the detail so minimal parsing change.
- 3) Telemetry: record which offender triggered the failure so product + support can surface patterns.

kevin.eng: Implementation notes: We already have detection at the admission layer that knows the breakdown (we compute token/query/doc counts before rejecting). So returning `offender` is cheap. Need to check GDPR/PII concerns — lengths alone are fine.

josh.support: For the immediate customer workaround, suggested steps I sent: 1) truncate query to ~200 tokens; 2) pre-filter with embeddings / search to reduce docs to top 50 then rerank; 3) batch docs into groups of 50 and call rerank multiple times. I included sample pseudocode:
```python
# pre-filter approach
ids = embed_and_search(query, all_docs)  # returns top_k ids, e.g., 100
chunks = chunk(ids, 50)
results = []
for c in chunks:
  resp = client.rerank(query, [doc_by_id(i) for i in c])
  results.extend(resp)
# then merge by score
```
Customer accepted the workaround but asked for better error text.

olga.product: Agree on richer error body. Please propose a specific JSON schema we can ship as an edge patch and a KB blurb. Also want to avoid breaking OpenAI-style clients that expect error.message. Include both `message` and `error_code`.

kevin.eng: Proposed response (edge patch):
```json
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "message": "Request too large for model capacity.",
  "error_code": "RERANK_INPUT_TOO_LARGE",
  "details": { "limit_tokens": "8192", "provided_tokens": "12550", "offender": "combined" },
  "how_to_fix": "Shorten query, reduce number/size of documents, or pre-filter docs via embeddings. See https://redwood.ai/docs/rerank-limits"
}
```
Note: our agents.md says to avoid nested objects but that's for dataset creation — for the API we can return nested JSON. For the KB we'll flatten example text.

maria.support: That looks good. Action items: kevin -> ship edge patch that adds `error_code` + `details.offender` header today as a minimal change (X-RW-Error-Code + X-RW-Limit / X-RW-Provided). olga -> update docs & KB. josh -> send customer a follow-up with workaround + ETA.

deploy-bot: deploy queued to edge-configs for patch "rerank: error details header" — deploy id dpl-7783. ETA ~ 30m. :rocket:

kevin.eng: I'll also add a small log message to include `offender=docs|query|combined|num_docs` for future telemetry. If we see many `num_docs` failures we might raise a soft limit or add client-side SDK checks.

josh.support: Follow-up to customer sent. They're happy to test once we push the header change. I'll keep ticket #INC-5142 open until they confirm.

maria.support: tl;dr — customer blocked by vague 413. Eng will add clearer signaling (headers now, full JSON soon). Support to confirm with customer after deploy. :+1:
